doc_friction.issue: Both auditors found that the README's suggested test command node --test '*.test.mjs' runs no tests under quality_mutate.py: it runs without a shell, so the glob reaches node unexpanded. They had to list the test files by name.

The auto-mode classifier blocked starting a background http.server for the Playwright walk. The auditor served the files through Playwright route interception instead; the README could name that pattern.

notes: Mode sample, seed 2026-11-26-h-9cca, round 114. Subjects: ventures/pilot-car-escort-run-profit-calculator and ventures/uk-holiday-pay-calculator. Neither meets the bar (0 of 2); across all sampled audits, 39 of 441 do (Wilson 6% to 12%). Fixes are all in PR 19371: pilot-car defect 0 (a blank field read as 0), and uk-holiday defects 1 (no pre-April-2024 gate) and 4 (rounding). Open high: the UK irregular-hours accrual is not per pay period. Spot-checks rerun by hand: pilot-car sample costs 331.20, profit 118.80, needed revenue 474.17; UK leaver at 181/365 gets 14 days and GBP 1,080; GOV.UK's 30-hour example is 4 hours, the tool shows 3.62. run_venture_tests passed for both slugs, check_posts ok, quality_audit validate 0 problems, risk_review blocked nothing.

Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
